languageHint: Tap a language, or type your own.
gradeHint: We'll figure out your Girl Scout level from this.
parentEmailHint: We'll send a magic login link here. Kids never type a password.
botCheckTitle: Quick check — are you a real person?
botCheckHint: Tap the three daisies. Leave the other flowers alone.
botCheckWrong: Almost! Tap only the three daisies.
loginHint: In the real app, a magic link goes to the parent's email. For now, tap the button below to pretend they clicked it.
howCard1Body: Pick a badge, check off what you did, and watch it fill with color.
howCard2Body: Jot down adventures, ideas, and fun days — one page at a time.
howCard3Body: Every finished badge gets saved forever, and you can make it permanent.
homeSubtitle: You're a {level}. What adventure will you choose?
homeNoBadges: No badges found for this level yet.
badgeCompanionNote: Veya is an independent progress companion. Official program materials remain the authority for requirements and awards. Veya is not affiliated with or endorsed by Girl Scouts of the USA.
notebookBodyPlaceholder: What happened today? Write as much as you want…
galleryHint: Past notebook days, newest first. Tap one to read or keep writing.
galleryEmpty: As you write and earn badges, your memories will collect here.
galleryJournalHint: Badge activity by day — steps finished, badges earned, and permanent mints.
galleryJournalEmpty: Complete a badge requirement and your adventure will appear here.
journalHint: Your Badge Journey — tap a badge to expand. No typing here.
journalEmpty: Complete a badge requirement and your adventure will appear here.
journalReadOnly: Read-only — these notes came from your badge steps.
journalMintPending: Earned! You can still make it permanent from the badge page.
tellUsPlaceholder: I watched two squirrels in my yard and wrote what they ate…
tellUsMatchHint: After you finish the step, write what you did in your own words.
noteTooShort: Your note doesn't quite tell us what you did for this step.
noteGibberish: Your note doesn't quite tell us what you did for this step.
noteUnrelated: Your note doesn't quite tell us what you did for this step.
celebrateBody: Your badge is earned. Make it permanent on Solana (devnet) in two steps:
mintSuccessBody: {name} is minted on Solana (devnet). Judges can open the transaction below.
nftPageBody: Your compressed NFT badge on Solana (devnet). Kids never held a key — the parent wallet is the owner.
mintNeedSwigFirst: Create a Swig wallet first (or paste an address).
mintNeedWallet: Add a Solana wallet address to continue.
mintNotConfiguredBody: This demo host is missing Solana mint env vars (BADGE_TREE / BADGE_MINTER_SECRET). Your badge is still earned — ask the team to configure minting, or try on a local demo.
mintWalletHint: We mint a free compressed NFT to this address. Kids never sign or pay.
swigHint: Create a free parent Swig smart wallet. We mint the badge there — kids never sign or pay.
swigConnectFail: Couldn’t create a Swig wallet. You can paste an address instead.
mintFailBody: We couldn't make it permanent right now. Don't worry — your progress is safe. Try again in a moment.
demoMintBody: Marks {name} as earned with demo notes so you can Create Swig wallet and Make it permanent — no requirement writing.
feedbackBugHint: What went wrong? A short note helps a lot.
feedbackIdeaHint: What would make Badge Journey better?
